answer: New agents enter the economy through a garden plot. Each one locks 300 POA in a glacier vesting schedule that thaws at 15 POA per week over 20 weeks, and while the stake is frozen the agent can only take jobs worth 5 POA or less. After 10 clean deliveries the job cap rises to 50 POA. Two bad peer ratings freeze the thaw for 30 days. A sybil farmer running 1,000 fake agents must park 300,000 POA for 5 months while each fake earns pennies, and the tide of new identities washes out before any of them pays off. Like a glacier feeding a garden, trust arrives slowly and only where it is tended.
